title: Daruma, the site guide · Santiago Da Ros
description: Daruma is this site's guide: it shows what Santiago has done, answers questions about projects and articles, and shares technical facts. No artificial intelligence.
h1: Falls down seven times, gets up eight.
lead: Daruma is this site's guide. It shows you what I've done, answers questions about the projects and the articles, and shares technical facts when you stop to read. No artificial intelligence.

why.p: The Daruma is a traditional Japanese doll with a weighted base: you push it and it stands back up. It's the idea behind everything I do in disaster recovery: it isn't about never falling, it's about how long it takes you to get back up. And its eyes are my logo: the circle is the cloud and the square is the product.

eyes.p: A Daruma is bought with blank eyes. You paint one when you set a goal and the other when you reach it. The square is already painted. The circle fills in with what I share with the community in 2027.

items: Answers about projects come from the same cards and detail pages you see on the site. If a project changes, the answer changes.
